top_choice_rationale: P003 pairs two mature, chemically explicit achievements with non-overlapping people: pKa-tuned ionizable lipid nanoparticles (Cullis, Anderson) as the carrier the 2023 Medicine prize left unrecognised, and base editing (Liu) as designed deaminase chemistry already in clinical use. It stays within the three-laureate cap and avoids the Vancouver trio's patent entanglement. P001 (protein degradation) is the most original chemistry and my close second, held back only by the absence of an approved degrader and the contested three-name cut; P004 is the same LNP science with a more contestable attribution.
